WITH container_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    c.containregistry,
    c.volliters,
    vd.vialtally,
    sd.tempdevcount,
    sd.critevents,
    sd.tempstabidx,
    -- SER = VialTally * 10 / VolLiters
    CAST(vd.vialtally * 10 AS numeric) / c.volliters AS ser,
    -- TSS = (1 - TempDevCount/100) * (1 - CritEvents/10) * TempStabIdx
    (1 - CAST(sd.tempdevcount AS numeric) / 100) 
      * (1 - CAST(sd.critevents AS numeric) / 10) 
      * sd.tempstabidx AS tss
  FROM container c
  JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
  JOIN sensordata sd ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry
)
SELECT 
  containregistry AS container_id,
  ROUND(CAST(ser AS numeric), 4) AS efficiency_score,
  ROUND(CAST(tss AS numeric), 4) AS temperature_stability,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ser DESC) AS rank
FROM container_metrics
WHERE ser > 0.8 AND tss > 0.9
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 5;

  SELECT 
    c.containregistry,
    c.volliters,
    c.coolremainpct,
    c.refilllatest,
    vd.vialtally,
    sd.tempdevcount,
    sd.critevents,

  FROM container c
  JOIN vaccinedetails vd ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
  JOIN sensordata sd ON sd.containlink = c.containregistry

)

ORDER BY ces DESC
